answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The fable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vault is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
